title: A Sleigh of One's Own
overview: One woman's journey of self-discovery and coming to terms with her husband's sexuality. That woman? Mrs. Claus.

title: Heart Eyes 2
overview: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: Third Love
overview: It's a story about some teen aged boy and girl of a University. A romantic story but in this story viewers will get a heavy sad and deep message. Which will make them realized a universal truth about transgender people and their feelings.

title: Tunes
overview: An aspiring artist, facing failure and self-doubt, strives to create a song that could potentially change his future.

title: Untitled Ocean's Prequel
overview: Follows Danny Ocean's parents, two masterminds, as they pull off an elaborate heist at the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix.

title: Twisted
overview: As the heir to her parents’ legendary pizzeria, Angelina, a feisty Italian teenager, fears breaking tradition might break their hearts. As her desire to break free grows, so do her lies. But when her web of deceit spins out of control, she opens a portal to a wondrous and treacherous mythical underworld putting her family in grave danger. To right her wrong, she is forced to team up with a neurotic but sensitive, truth-telling monster. The unlikely duo sets off on a mind-blowing journey to save the very traditions Angelina wanted to leave behind. A modern coming-of-age adventure, Twisted explores the universal themes of soul-searching. It challenges our relationship with truth, lies and looks at how life-changing decisions can sometimes affect the people we love.

title: Orphans
overview: A ruthless con artist targets a wealthy European household, but her calculated scheme hits an unexpected snag when someone discovers her dark past and vows to expose her true identity.

title: A Place in Hell
overview: A top criminal defense attorney, known for representing unlikeable clients in high-profile cases, is a relentless workhorse at her firm and fully expects to be named partner. When another attorney joins the firm, her job is put to the test and makes her question just how far she’ll go to protect it.

title: Up Against It
overview: Álvaro and his ex-wife Saffron attempt to set aside the drama of their messy divorce for the sake of their daughter Rose.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: Get to That Place
overview: A group of kids navigate their lives and interpersonal relationships while a rumor about the end of the world spreads around town.

title: The Defectors
overview: In a near-future surveillance state, a detective secretly aligned with a rebellion investigates the assassination of their leader under the watchful eye of his manipulative new partner.

title: One Sweet Hour
overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.

title: Little Flower
overview: An ominous dream pushes Layla, a directionless twenty-something to reconnect with an old friend.

title: Christmas at the Zoo
overview: An entrepreneur brokering a sponsorship to build the city zoo's new penguin habitat finds herself caught between business and romance after falling for a compassionate zookeeper over the holidays.

title: Jimmy
overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Brute 1986
overview: Leather Kobra, a Sunset Strip-style glam metal band, films a music video in an abandoned Western town in the middle of nowhere. Ignoring ‘no trespassing’ signs, the rebellious group have no idea they are being watched by the Birdy family, who will meet them with a level of brutality that is as vicious as it is creative.

title: Exposure
overview: An anxious small-town cop falls down a rabbit hole after finding a VHS tape in a missing girl's bedroom.

title: It Appears in a Flash!
overview: A Man, holding a bloody axe in his hands. Not remember who he is nor the horrors that haunts him. Having only a Polaroid camera, he is being hunted by IT. This 'it' reveals itself only in a flash of light.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: In the Name of Love
overview: A gay couple talks about love, visibility, and making erotic films together in Malaysia, where queer life has long been criminalized.

title: Kiwi Food
overview: Aboard Orbit International Rail, Phileas outruns his roots that hold him back, but with every passing landscape, he's pulled closer to the question he can't escape: where in the world does he truly belong?

title: Vespers
overview: Adrift after her Unitarian Universalist church is firebombed, a Midwestern woman attempts to welcome two promoters renting out the congregation’s basement for a DIY punk gig.

title: Roof
overview: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

title: Run Terry Run
overview: The extraordinary story of Canadian icon Terry Fox will be told like never before in Run Terry Run, a new feature-length documentary directed by acclaimed filmmaker Sean Menard. The film offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at Terry’s legendary 1980 Marathon of Hope, drawing from 96 reels of never-before-seen footage and unheard audio interviews that have remained untouched for 45 years.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: From the Ashes
overview: Two old buddies reunite to scatter the ashes of their friend and brother. Unbeknownst to them, they are soon to be visited by their late companion from beyond the grave.

title: Secrets of the Southwest
overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
original_title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

title: Journey
overview: Roberto is a young man trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is at the heart of his odyssey. Along his journey, Roberto is constantly faced with the temptation to quit and give in to defeat. However, it is the voice of those who came before him that fuels his passion for legacy.

title: Burned Edges
overview: Burned Edges is a culinary drama about ambition pushed too far.  Inside the relentless heat of a pizza kitchen, a driven chef sacrifices sleep, love, and loyalty in pursuit of greatness slowly burning the very relationships that once grounded him.  It’s a story about overwork, obsession, and the cost of chasing a dream without knowing when to stop.

title: Beware Boiúna
overview: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: Drury Lane
overview: A flat tire leaves realtor James stranded on the side of the road. He’s now at the mercy of a stranger who finds himself on the same road, on the same night, at the same time…

title: Scammed
overview: Millions of Americans have fallen victim to a growing epidemic of online scams, from sextortion schemes aimed at teens to crypto investment scams targeting seniors.  FRONTLINE and Associated Press have spent more than a year investigating this shadowy world that's grown into a global criminal industry, powered in many cases by organized crime, trafficked labor, American technology, and, increasingly, Al.

title: Doll of Deceit
overview: A woman's affair with a hired handyman takes a dark turn when her husband discovers the betrayal, leading to a suspenseful tale of captivity and an eerie transformation that blurs the line between reality and nightmare. Who will survive?

title: Chimp Outbreak
overview: An aggressive chimp has escaped confinement and creates a path of death and destruction.

title: Globe
overview: Globe is a cinematic folktale about identity, belonging, and resistance, set amid the tribal land struggles of Kerala. Seen through Kariyan, a young tribal boy, the film reflects the deep bond indigenous communities share with their land and the alienation they face in urban society. Rooted in Attappadi, the story subtly reveals ancestral dispossession and cultural erasure, urging reflection on justice, dignity, and the right to remain in one’s birthplace.

title: Dog-End Balm
overview: A person tries to find their missing sentient cigarette as three narrators express frustrations.

title: Ann Arbor After Asphyxia
overview: The summer my dad died, I rediscovered the last birthday card he ever wrote for me.

title: The Voyage
overview: Ekkapong Saransett Songkhla artist and film director created a moving photo exhibition tribute to his late father, who was a Thai-Chinese diaspora. The birth of a small life through the world war, the Chinese Revolution Starting life by Songkhla Lake The work consists of historical animation and memories combined with audio work from J Wattankuljarat (JPBS member) to tell a personal history through the sound of gunfire, sea, and fireworks. We all begin from somewhere

title: STAR GIRLS
overview: A teenage girl, Maria, discovers that her best friend, Alex, has been secretly pursuing her crush, Ivan, just before their drama performance. As tensions rise during rehearsal, Maria confronts Alex, and what begins as a painful betrayal quickly escalates into a heated altercation between the two friends.

title: Outgrowth
overview: A young girl forms an unlikely bond with the disembodied hand beneath her bed.

title: INT3RV1EW
overview: A teenage boy's ordinary day takes a surreal turn when he goes to a routine job interview. Living with his roommate, he expects a simple experience, until the interview takes a dark turn.  Crafted by rising Australian filmmakers G31 Productions, this short film blends horror, thrills, and twists, leaving audiences questioning what’s real.

title: Other Half
overview: After cheating on her girlfriend, Jade (Grace Rolek) finds herself isolated in a world of newfound heart break. Determined to suffer through the grieving process alone, she refuses to answer calls, texts or communicate with friends and family. In her booze-soaked depression, Jade attempts to rediscover what being alone really means. With no one to blame but herself, she indulges in self-destructive behavior to cope. Despite her attempts to ignore her estranged best friend Avery (Cleopatra Boudreau), Jade is surprised to find her showing up at her door and entering (well, stampeding) into her space. What unfolds is a night of reckoning and rediscovery of their friendship.

title: Lighter : strictly non veg
overview: Two friends, Sunny & Mathew, as a simple late-night plan for a drink takes an unexpected turn.

title: D&D, but It’s Minecraft
overview: recreated all of Minecraft's mechanics in Dungeons & Dragons, and trapped my friends in a room until they beat the game. feat. ‪@TommyInnit‬ and ‪@JackManifoldTV‬ Enjoy the greatest Minecraft speedrun of all time.

title: Their laugher proves my existence
overview: A clown entertains an audiance.

title: Wild
overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

title: The Route to Cappyness
overview: A filmmaker embarks on a global adventure to uncover the viral fascination of the capybara, including exploring how they have become cultural symbols of serenity in Japan.

title: Lycanthropy
overview: A young woman wanders through a forest with unease, unaware of the violent creature lurking closely behind. This was created for an assignment in an Audio/Visual Productions class.

title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
original_title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
overview: “Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness” is a feature documentary that explores all the major psychedelics, not just by explaining how they work medicinally, but by taking viewers inside dosing rooms for extremely rare looks at the remarkable power, emotion, and speed of psychedelic healing in action: from pro athletes repairing brain damage from concussions, to combat veterans finding relief from suicidal despair, to a woman breaking free from opioid addiction, to survivors of the Nova Music Festival massacre who say being on psychedelics during the attack shielded them from developing mental trauma.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: Creatures
overview: In Amsterdam, a queer Polish tattoo artist creates creatures that become part of other people's bodies. Through fandoms, online communities, and kindred spirits, we explore the world surrounding the artist, Pazur Mazur.

title: Dogwood
overview: "DOGWOOD" is a tale of survival, revenge, and the enduring strength of a mother's love as Harriet confronts the darkest depths of human nature to protect what is rightfully hers.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: The Stray House
overview: After losing his husband, a grieving widower inherits a rundown house and transforms it into a refuge for society’s outcasts—creating an unlikely chosen family that must stand together against prejudice, abuse, and the pain of the past.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Mickey+ Shorts: Mickey + Toy Story
overview: Mickey along with Pixar's Toy Story friends Woody, Buzz, and Jessie celebrates the wonder and joy of play.

title: The Master of Many Worlds
overview: A dreamlike glimpse of a nightwatchman and his partner on their rounds.

title: I Don’t Love You Anymore
overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: One Last Shot
overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: COLECTIVO: The First Year
overview: Go behind the scenes of COLECTIVO's inaugural year, as three emerging Latinx filmmakers receive mentorship from Lin-Manuel Miranda and Tribeca Studios, culminating in a Tribeca Festival premiere. Three bold new voices. One extraordinary fellowship.

title: Eons
overview: A study of time's dark-flowering unknown center.

title: Fight of Fury 2 Retaliation
overview: Brandon exerts great effort and patience to rescue his daughter, abducted by a sex trafficker named Brutal. He comes so close to meeting his nemesis, but the villain escapes to avoid capture by the authorities, who he fears more than Brandon. The search must continue, or all is lost!

title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
original_title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
overview: A four part ambiguation of "weirdness" in relation to the sublime. A sensory ode to incongruity. A brief and romantic gesture toward un-understanding. A prayer to the anti-self.

title: Raddi
overview: When time slips through our fingers like sand, the greatest gift our loved ones can give us is the feeling that, even as everything changes, we still matter.

title: SHOWGIRLS - the Da Da Edit
overview: A lesbian rewrite of an already lesbian film. Rotoscoped with reverence.

title: Demoni Ferox: Night People Stole My Baby
original_title: Demoni Ferox: Night People Stole My Baby
overview: Surreal nightmares haunt a young couple until late one stormy night, when they are visited by the Night People.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
original_title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
overview: From protein pitfalls to considered choices, Gemma Atkinson, Dr Jack Mosley and Lucy Watson cut through the hype to discover the truth about the consumer health obsession

title: Spidernado
overview: A quiet countryside is plunged into chaos when a monstrous tornado tears across the region—only to reveal something far worse riding in its winds.

title: Keirra
overview: A lonely student, raised under her mother’s suffocating control, finds love and confidence through a film that finally lets her be seen. But when a humiliating video is exposed, her breakdown becomes a reckoning — and the girl who wanted attention learns what it means to be unforgettable.

title: Happier Times
overview: Two friends reunite for the first time in a while & come to realize how much life has changed

title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
original_title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
overview: Caffeine-deprived Cand Caff’s day goes from bad to apocalyptic when his sentient fridge threatens to blow up the entire neighborhood unless he delivers a fresh energy drink — fast. What follows is a chaotic sprint filled with push-up battles, Karen attacks, and unhinged inner demons in this pitch-black, low-budget comedy.  The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End cranks the absurdity, self-loathing, and dark humor to eleven while somehow feeling like the start of something much bigger.

title: Women of Dominica
overview: An intergenerational story of ten women on the Caribbean island of Dominica, interwoven through mentorship, matriarchal wisdom, and ancestral heritage. Bound by the love for their island, the film honors their resilience, identity, and cultural legacy.

title: Pathetic Fallacy
overview: A young widower arrives in a new-age mountain town in search of cosmic answers and a chance to heal. Instead, he finds an outlandish murderer and a forest of demonic spirits who offer a horrific bargain: the power to cheat death at a nightmarish cost.

title: Where Sins Are Buried
overview: After the death of their bank robber father, twin siblings Tom and Anne are forced to pay for his past crimes when they are visited by their long-lost half-brother.

title: Bomarzo Tremor
overview: 'Bomarzo Tremor' draws from the Sacro Bosco of Bomarzo, Italy, to imagine a seismic awakening of its sculptures, an image-tremor that shakes them out of stillness. The film triggers this quake through analog techniques that alter the celluloid, making what is petrified seem to move, and letting the tremor spread into the town itself.

title: Khamenei's Last Move
overview: For thirty-six vears, Ali Khamenei prepared Iran for a confrontation he believed would eventually come.  This documentary traces the doctrine he built, the forces that challenged it, and the war that ultimately reached his own home.  He could have moved. He didn't  Did Khamenei simply accept the risk--or did he understand what his death could set in motion?

title: Heart of the Beast
overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: Peculiar Green
overview: A middle-aged man with deity-like powers details the creation of his new world. A world characterized by a shade of green.

title: Ten Years of Nicus Studios
overview: September 18th, 2026 marks ten years since Nicus Studios began uploading to YouTube. So to celebrate, this documentary explores the history of Nicus Studios

title: Perspektywy
overview: Seven girls, seven stories, and one point of view.

title: Edgar Allan Poe’s Murder Mystery Dinner Party: The Musical
original_title: Edgar Allan Poe’s Murder Mystery Dinner Party: The Musical
overview: Edgar Allan Poe is throwing a murder mystery dinner party, and you’re invited—alongside his ghostly sidekick Lenore and a room full of famous authors, all with something to hide. But as the wine flows and the fake murders become real, guests start dropping like flies. Whodunnit? Why!? And who’s next?!!  Join literary legends from Mary Shelley and Lewis Carroll to Jane Austen and Oscar Wilde as they scramble to solve the mystery, protect their secrets, and defend their outsized egos.  Based on the hit web series, this brand-new musical serves up mystery, mayhem, and original songs in one delightfully deadly night of theatre.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: Premature
overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

title: The Depths
overview: After a brother and sister achieve astral projection, the footage they capture reveals the malicious effects of their family trauma.

title: Mackenzie
overview: Eleven-year-old Juniper runs away from home and sets out across the Utah desert, determined to reach California and marry her television crush, Mackenzie Astin. Along the way, her unlikely journey becomes a search for connection, independence, and a place to belong.

title: Sweetest Day
overview: ‘Survivor girl’ Mindy prepares for the battle of her life against the undead confederate soldier that nearly killed her once before.

title: TEENAGERS
overview: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

title: Kill Me Now
overview: A writer on a deadline to finish her first Hollywood thriller seeks solace in her home. Life imitates art as she becomes convinced her neighbor is going to kill her.

title: Espresso Martini
overview: When Jensen’s freshly formed frontal lobe develops an insatiable thirst for pure, unadulterated grind-force, he has to learn how to mix things up and sip more slowly.

title: Godmother
overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

title: Zippy's House
overview: A troubled teen is forced to attend his strange classmate's birthday.

title: Infinitely Dense
overview: Tom, a painfully pragmatic solipsist, disenchanted with his life, employs an augmented reality system to rejuvenate his life, only to discover the unintended dark and disturbing consequence of manipulating reality.

title: NO, I'M NOT A HUMAN!
overview: As a deadly solar crisis forces people indoors, an isolated homeowner reluctantly shelters two strangers while television reports warn that inhuman “visitors” are disguising themselves as ordinary people.

title: Midnight Murungai
overview: A downbeat Toronto-Tamil millennial finds her plan for a free-house is thwarted by her kooky Mom who is acting suspicious.

title: Lizzie
overview: A young woman, Eliza, returns to her hometown for summer break, and must confront a fragment of her past.

title: The Long Way to Tipperary
overview: A man returns home.

title: 70 Up
overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

title: Future Tense
overview: Cape Town, South Africa. In a near future on the brink of climate collapse, Lwando and his girlfriend Tara are among the privileged few who win the opportunity to travel back to 1647 and a pre-colonial past to experience nature in its wildest form. Lwando is an underground activist who dreams of changing the course of history. Tara wants to save her relationship with him. Together, the couple must choose whether to risk life as they know it for a potentially better world.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: The Phone Booth
overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

title: Cassilda's Song
overview: Based on The King in Yellow by Robert W. Chambers, Cassilda's Song follows Cassie, a gifted but insecure art student who becomes obsessed with Sylvia, an enigmatic model whose presence seems to awaken something extraordinary in her work. What begins as creative admiration becomes intimacy, ritual, and obsession. As Cassie's art grows increasingly strange and symbolic, her desire to create something perfect begins to consume her.

title: Betty
overview: A young woman is haunted by the dead lady in her tub.

title: Still Night, Burning House
overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: CONTACT
overview: CONTACT is a short documentary film directed by Jonathan Walley that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument—where the skate, BMX, art, and music scenes collide.  HCS has been many things: a skatepark, gallery, library, museum, and stage; but, for one weekend, Derek Nelson fabricator,  activist, BMX pro, and artist, transformed his skatepark into an immersive sonic installation—part instrument, part playground—for the community of Binghamton, NY to become co‑creators in a conflagration of sound. SMALL TOWN, BIG SOUND.  CONTACT reminds us of the joy in creativity, community, and the DIY spirit. Contact is about pushing boundaries, experimenting with art, and reclaiming space in an increasingly cruel, unkind, and oppressive world. It’s a poetic exploration of the creative process told by a filmmaker who calls HCS home.

title: Malevolent
overview: A construction worker, arrives at a house he is assigned to demolish, only to have the place reopen the shadows of his past.

title: Tickets, Please.
overview: On her daily commute to work, an aspiring entrepreneur has recurring visions of a man finding a duffel bag full of cash. But when she encounters strange people who suddenly become rich in unexpected ways, her reality begins to unravel as she struggles with the unseen powers which determine fate and fortune.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: The Train
overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.
